item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-11-24 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 11 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. 1 of this week's additions are associated with known ransomware campaigns. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (6). Apache has the most new KEV entries this week (2).
